messages:
maria: Quick question — for console analytics presets, should we treat "scope" as a property of the preset or as implied by where you save it? Need per-route / per-model filters and clear ownership for sharing.

jamie: I think explicit property. People get confused when a saved preset appears in other routes. Scope dropdown: [route | model | team | org | global]

ravi: +1. Also need an 'owner' and 'visibility' (private/team/org). Team defaults to route's owning team.

maria: UX concern: we don't want too many dropdowns. Could default to 'route' when saving from route context, with a small 'scope' chip you can change.

tomas: From infra side, scoping to model vs route matters for telemetry joins. If scoped to model we should allow cross-route aggregation, otherwise restrict indices. Need metadata on saved preset: scope enum, owner_id, visibility, and optional allowed_routes list.

console-bot: deploy scheduled — analytics-service 2.4.0 -> prod (rolling) at 2026-04-01 03:00 UTC

olivia: Suggest adding 'pinned context' — when you open a preset, show a banner: "This preset is scoped to model X; viewing on route Y may filter differently." keeps users informed.

jamie: Also: search + filters UI: prebuilt filter tokens for 'route', 'model', 'deployment', 'model_variant'. People often want to pin model_variant.

mike: For access control, map visibility to team membership + an audit log entry when a preset is edited/shared.

ravi: Implementation note: keep the saved preset compact — store a canonical filter expression string and a view config (columns, time range, visualization type) and a scope enum.

maria: Action items: 1) Jamie to mock scope chip and new save modal (due Tue). 2) Tomas to propose minimal metadata schema + index strategy (due Wed). 3) Ravi to spec audit/ACL mapping and copy for visibility (due Fri). 4) I'll write short copy for the banner. :memo:

jamie: I'll attach a quick Figma link when ready — @maria @ravi

ravi: One more edge case: quotas. If a preset runs heavy ad-hoc aggregations, show estimated cost / row scans and offer an async run option.

maria: Good call — inline cost estimate in the header when saving or running a heavy query.

tomas: For async runs: create a background job and store job_id in preset run history. We'll add status webhooks for the console so third-party tools can subscribe.

olivia: UX note: add a "clone to new scope" flow — let someone take a route-scoped preset and make a global or model-scoped copy.

maria: Perfect. We'll sync in design critique tomorrow. Thanks all :tada:
